key: nvidia|principal product manager laptop gpu and soc
title: Principal Product Manager - Laptop GPU and SoC
jd_excerpt:
As Principal Product Manager (SoC/RTX Spark & Discrete Graphics), you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our laptop product line and experiences. If you’re a tech enthusiast with a passion for Local AI, creation, and gaming, and can lead large cross-functional teams with a dedicated work ethic, this role is tailor-made for you!
 What You'll Be Doing: 
 Closely partner across engineering, marketing, and external partners to define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and innovations.
 Develop and communicate a clear product positioning for the laptop lineup.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align product strategy.
 Continuously optimize product offerings based on data-driven insights.
 Stay abreast of industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer needs.
 Work closely with marketing, sales, and engineering teams to drive product adoption.
 What We Need to See: 
 15+ years of overall experience in product management.
 4+ years of leadership experience.
 Enthusiast with creation, AI, and gaming experience and a vision for where AI will take revolution these in the future.
 Experience working with partners and the ecosystem through the full product life cycle: inception, launch, and customer management.
 Strong analytical, marketing, and project management skills - a drive for results and a history of successful execution on projects.
 Demonstrated experience leading large, cross-functional projects and collaborating with executive leadership.
 Ability to work physically at NVIDIA’s Santa Clara headquarters and travel on occasion for partner meetings and events.
 Bachelor’s degree in electrical or computer engineering, Business, Marketing, or similar field (or equivalent experience).
 Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd: 
 Expertise in Local AI hardware, ecosystem, and software stack.
 Strong PC ecosystem expertise.
 NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 232,500 USD – 442,000 USD. 
 You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . 
 Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 29, 2026. 
 This posting is for an existing vacancy. 
 NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.
NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.
